correctness.summary: Repeated mixed differentiation gives the Euler-operator density formula for product inner blocks. For FGM this reduces to 1+theta(1-2^m u)(1-2^n v), whose exact extrema yield the necessary and sufficient admissibility interval. The explicit m=2,n=1,theta=1 point has density -35/64. The entropy defect follows from exact second moments of products of independent uniforms and is independently checked with rational arithmetic.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: The new Lu preprint states unrestricted closure and entropy additivity but does not contain this FGM obstruction. Prior nested-Archimedean work establishes compatibility restrictions in other constructions and is not claimed. Searches did not locate the exact FGM threshold family, product-inner Euler-operator formula, or entropy-curvature defect; broad older nested-copula literature remains a residual risk for an equivalent special case.

value.summary: The result identifies a concrete failure of the central proposed composition law, gives sharp admissibility thresholds rather than only a counterexample, and shows that the associated entropy theorem fails even in the valid smooth subrange.

limitations: Exact thresholds cover a bivariate FGM outer copula with independence inner blocks.
No general characterization of arbitrary copula substitutions is given.
The entropy discrepancy is a local expansion around theta=0.
Older nested-copula literature is extensive and may contain an equivalent special case under different terminology.
Independent audit has not been performed.
review_statement: Same-model review: passed. Independent audit: not yet performed.
